info.title: Mesbah API

post.description: Makes a project for the new model and queues its training on the approved replies of the projects named and the library datasets chosen. When it finishes, the model joins the library and becomes the project's base, so it can be chatted with and fine-tuned like any other.

Parameters by part, the share the vocabulary takes, and the memory to train it on this machine. When `tokenizer` names a model in the library with a larger vocabulary, the design is counted at that size, as training will build it. A design that can't be built answers 400 with `design_<reason>`.

post.description: Starts a session. Refused credentials answer 403, not 401: DRF downgrades AuthenticationFailed when no authenticator can offer a WWW-Authenticate challenge, and cookie auth has none. The reason is in the body.
